child._comment: W_C — the SOUGHT/CONJECTURED emergent wrapper. The trunk node — except here the trunk node is HOLLOW: it is a named target with no settled referent. This hollowness is the specimen's signature finding.
child.name: Quantum gravity (sought / conjectured — NO settled child yet)
child.kernel: The sought net product: a single framework in which gravity (spacetime geometry) is described quantum-mechanically — i.e. a theory that (a) reduces to General Relativity in the low-energy / large-scale limit, (b) reduces to Quantum Field Theory in the no-gravity / flat-background limit, (c) is well-defined at the Planck scale where both parents break down, and (d) accounts microscopically for black-hole entropy S=A/4. CRUCIAL: this kernel is a SPECIFICATION OF A TARGET, not a description of an existing object. No theory yet meets all of (a)-(d) to the field's satisfaction; instead there is a FAMILY of competing candidate kernels (string/M-theory, loop quantum gravity, causal sets/CDT/spin foams, asymptotic safety, ...), each of which the other camps reject as not-even-the-right-question.
child._frame_note: space+time inherited from GR (the geometry being quantized); knowledge inherited from QM (the probabilistic/operator description). 'meaning' enters only at the meta-level (the sociological 'which child is winning' contest, see frame_of_weld and the whig-vs-revisionist discrepancy), not in the physics kernel itself.

child._confidence_note: 0.4 = confidence that a SINGLE, distinct, settled emergent wrapper 'quantum gravity' (a) exists or (b) will exist / (c) is even the right question. It is low because (i) the child has not consolidated in ~90 years, (ii) serious dissenters hold no weld is needed at all (semiclassical gravity — the child may be a category error), and (iii) the rival candidates disagree about what the child even IS. Compare: the 9 Phase-1 convergences carry child-confidence ~0.85+. This 0.4 is the frontier signature.

So utility here is split into 'realized-by-the-search' vs 'promised-by-the-child'.
utility.unifier: PROMISED (the entire point): a genuine quantum gravity would be the deepest unification in physics — folding gravity into the same quantum framework as the other three forces, completing the arc EM->electroweak->(strong)->gravity. REALIZED-ALREADY-BY-THE-SEARCH (this is the surprise): the seam itself produced the HOLOGRAPHIC PRINCIPLE / AdS/CFT, which DID unify quantum field theory with gravity in a special (anti-de Sitter) setting and now bridges quantum-information, condensed-matter, and gravity — a unification the search delivered before the child consolidated. passesW_CTest: UNDECIDED for the child (no settled W_C to test); PASSES for the AdS/CFT grandchild.

This is a PRINCIPLED null, not a lazy blank: the compression leg is intrinsically undefined while the child is unborn (see bits_note and gaps). The one PARTIAL realized compressor is black-hole entropy S=A/4: it compresses 'all the microstates inside a horizon' into a single area, a holographic (area-not-volume) compression that is the search's hardest-won and most compressing result.

weld._comment: The merge: parents -> child. THE HEART OF THE SPECIMEN. Here the weld is an ~90-YEAR-OLD OPEN CONJECTURE in the schema's own sense — a low-confidence weld DRAWN (the seam is agreed) but NOT CONFIRMED (no child consolidated). It is also the schema's cleanest case of ONE seam yielding MANY rival welds (string covariant line / LQG canonical line / sum-over-histories line / ...), which the two-parent-one-child schema cannot natively express. See discrepancies[0].

parents.name: General Relativity (Einstein 1915)
parents.kernel: Gravity IS spacetime curvature: matter-energy tells spacetime how to curve (the Einstein field equations), and spacetime tells matter how to move. Classical, deterministic, geometric, and crucially BACKGROUND-INDEPENDENT — the metric is itself the dynamical variable, the theory is diffeomorphism-invariant, there is no fixed stage. frame {space,time}.
parents._confidence_note: Mature, experimentally confirmed to high precision: Mercury perihelion, light bending / lensing, gravitational redshift, GPS corrections, direct gravitational-wave detection (LIGO 2015), and event-horizon imaging (EHT: M87* 2019, Sgr A* 2022).

parents.name: Quantum Mechanics / Quantum Field Theory (1925-26 QM; QED/QFT 1927-1950s)
parents.kernel: Physical quantities are operators with probabilistic (not definite) values; fields are quantized into particles; dynamics run on a FIXED background spacetime with time as an external parameter; renormalization tames the infinities for the other three forces. frame {knowledge,time} (probabilistic state, external clock).
parents._confidence_note: The Standard Model (QFT's culmination) is the most precisely tested theory in physics (e.g. electron g-2 agreement to ~12 significant figures).

weld.shared_sub_object_S: S = the regime where BOTH theories must simultaneously apply AND where each predicts the other should NOT be trusted: the PLANCK SCALE (l_P ~ 1.6e-35 m, t_P ~ 5.4e-44 s, E_P ~ 1.2e19 GeV), reached by combining exactly the three constants G (gravity, from W_A), hbar (quantum, from W_B) and c (relativity, shared) — the cGh corner of the Gamow-Ivanenko-Landau / Bronstein 'cube of theories'. Concretely S has THREE FACES, each a real overlap the parents share but answer differently: (1) the GRAVITON — a massless spin-2 quantum of the gravitational field, a notion BOTH the linearized-GR-as-spin-2-field reading (Fierz-Pauli 1939) and QFT admit (named ~1934, Blokhintsev-Galperin); (2) BLACK HOLES — GR solutions that nonetheless radiate thermally and carry entropy S=A/4 (Bekenstein 1973, Hawking 1974), a statement simultaneously gravitational, thermodynamic AND quantum, demanding a microscopic (quantum) account of geometric AREA; (3) the EARLY UNIVERSE / curvature SINGULARITIES, where GR's own equations break down and quantum effects are forced. S is GENUINE OVERLAP, not a pile: the same physical situation (Planck-scale geometry, the horizon, t=0) is JOINTLY claimed by both parents, and each parent declares the OTHER ill-defined there. That mutual ill-definedness at the shared seam is precisely what makes a weld necessary — and what has resisted consummation for ~90 years.
weld._shared_sub_object_S_note: HIGH confidence: that S (Planck scale, graviton, black-hole entropy, singularities) is a real shared seam where both parents apply and clash is essentially undisputed across all camps. The DISAGREEMENT is not about S but about the DIRECTION of the weld over S (which parent's kernel to keep) — see discrepancies[1]. This is the certain core of the specimen.
weld.surprise: The deepest surprise is STRUCTURAL and is what makes QG the schema's signature FRONTIER case rather than a settled convergence: the two parents, pushed together at S, do NOT yield ONE third — they yield a CONTRADICTION that forces a CHOICE about which parent's deepest commitment to keep, and each choice grows a DIFFERENT proposed child that the OTHER child's adherents reject as not-even-the-right-question. Neither parent alone predicts this. (i) QM alone never predicts that quantizing the metric DESTROYS THE BACKGROUND you quantize against (the recursion: ordinary QFT needs a fixed stage to define fluctuations; here the stage IS the thing fluctuating) — this 'problem of time' and the loss of local observables emerge only from BOTH parents jointly. (ii) GR alone never predicts black-hole entropy S=A/4 finite and proportional to AREA not VOLUME — a holographic, information-theoretic fact needing hbar AND G AND c together, which became the single hardest constraint and the richest seed (it later spawned the holographic principle and AdS/CFT). (iii) Within the COVARIANT proposed-weld specifically, the standout LOCAL surprise (1974, Scherk-Schwarz & Yoneya): a theory built to model the STRONG nuclear force was found to NECESSARILY contain a massless spin-2 state in its closed-string spectrum interacting exactly like a graviton — string theory 'predicts gravity whether you want it or not', a result neither hadron physics nor GR forecast; the response was to shrink the string ~20 orders of magnitude to the Planck length and reinterpret the whole edifice as quantum gravity. (iv) Within the CANONICAL proposed-weld (LQG), the standout surprise: AREA and VOLUME operators have DISCRETE spectra (Rovelli-Smolin 1994-95) — space is granular at the Planck scale, with a smallest possible area — a quantitative Planck-scale prediction falling out of taking GR's background-independence and QM's operator-spectra seriously together, labelled by Penrose's spin networks (drawn ~1964 for an unrelated reason). THE META-SURPRISE FOR THE SCHEMA: this is a weld whose SYNERGY is real and enormous (it reorganized all of fundamental physics) yet whose CHILD has NOT consolidated for ~90 years — synergy WITHOUT a settled W_C. The surprise is partly that a genuine high-synergy seam can stay an open conjecture for a human lifetime, splitting into rival children instead of fusing into one.
weld._surprise_confidence_note: HIGH (0.85): that the seam produces genuine, non-additive synergy — reachable only from both parents jointly — is well-attested (the graviton-in-string-spectrum result, S=A/4, the problem of time, discrete spectra are all real and load-bearing). Deliberately DECOUPLED from child-confidence (0.4): synergy is real even though the child is unborn. This decoupling is itself a finding (see gaps).

weld._frame_of_weld_note: The PHYSICS of the weld holds in {space,time,knowledge} (geometry + probabilistic operators). BUT this specimen uniquely also engages {meaning}: because there is no settled child, WHICH candidate is 'winning' is a sociological, observer- and era-relative judgment (string-by-headcount dominance since the mid-1980s; partial reversal after the LHC found no SUSY) — a meaning-frame contest, not a view-from-nowhere fact. The weld's resolution is currently being adjudicated in the meaning frame as much as the knowledge frame. See the whig-vs-revisionist discrepancy.
weld.lod_scale: HOLDS at the coarsest grain only: at field-level zoom, 'GR + QM must be reconciled at the Planck scale' is a single, agreed weld. ZOOM IN ONE STEP and it SHATTERS into mutually-rejecting sub-welds (covariant/string vs canonical/LQG vs sum-over-histories vs asymptotic-safety vs ...), each claiming to be THE weld and calling the others wrong. So the lod_scale behaviour is the inverse of a healthy weld: a settled convergence holds when you zoom in (sub-structure confirms it); THIS weld DISSOLVES when you zoom in (sub-structure contradicts itself). That inversion is a diagnostic of an unconsummated weld.

dormancy_intervals.why: FIELD-LEVEL dormancy ('the Middle Ages', Rovelli's periodization). 'The seventies soon disappoint the hopes of the sixties': the Wheeler-DeWitt equation proves too ill-defined for calculations; non-renormalizability of GR is confirmed ('t Hooft-Veltman 1973 one-loop-with-matter; Goroff-Sagnotti 1985-86 two-loop nail for pure gravity); supergravity and higher-derivative rescue attempts fail. 'The landscape of quantum gravity is gloomy.' CAUSE-FRAME: internal / knowledge-frame (no-go theorems + ill-definedness).

NODE-LEVEL dormancy: Penrose's SPIN NETWORKS lay dormant ~20-25 years (sources vary on the exact span; see date/attribution discrepancy). Drawn ~1964 for an unrelated combinatorial-geometry reason (existing first only as a handwritten manuscript; published 1971), then REVIVED 1988-90 when Rovelli-Smolin found they exactly label the quantum-geometry states of LQG. Rovelli: 'the idea will surprisingly re-emerge.' CAUSE-FRAME: tool-orphaning / knowledge-frame (a premature tool awaiting a host).

ROOT-LEVEL dormancy: Matvei Bronstein's foundational mid-1930s work went dormant for DECADES after his execution by the Soviet NKVD in February 1938 (age 32, nephew of Trotsky). Reconstructed only recently (Stachel; Gorelik & Frenkel biography). CAUSE-FRAME: EXTERNAL / physical-political-frame — a death/purge severing a lineage, NOT an internal-to-the-idea cause. The schema's single 'why' string cannot tag that this dormancy was physical-frame while the others were knowledge-frame (see gaps: dormancy.why_frame).

roots._comment: DOWN, in the PHYSICAL frame. The recursive descent toward people and place. Confidence FADES and depth RISES going deeper. NOTE the unusual structure: because BOTH parents share deep sub-wrappers (the action principle, symmetry/group theory), the roots already OVERLAP below the seam S — part of why a weld feels possible at all.

sub_wrappers.name: Special Relativity (Einstein 1905; Lorentz-Poincare lineage)
sub_wrappers.kernel: Spacetime as a unified Minkowski geometry; invariance of c; the relativity of simultaneity. A constituent of GR (the flat-spacetime / no-gravity limit).
sub_wrappers.who_called_it: Einstein 1905; geometry by Minkowski 1908; contested priority with Lorentz-Poincare (a separate specimen).

sub_wrappers.name: Equivalence principle (gravity = acceleration)
sub_wrappers.kernel: Locally, a gravitational field is indistinguishable from acceleration — Einstein's 'happiest thought'; the conceptual seed that gravity is geometry.

sub_wrappers.name: Riemannian / differential geometry (the math substrate of GR)
sub_wrappers.kernel: Curved-manifold geometry; metric tensor; curvature; the Ricci-Levi-Civita tensor calculus that GR is written in.
sub_wrappers.who_called_it: Riemann 1854; tensor calculus by Ricci & Levi-Civita (1900); supplied to Einstein via Grossmann.

sub_wrappers.name: Quantum mechanics (the operator/probabilistic substrate of QFT)
sub_wrappers.kernel: State vectors; operators; non-commutation; Born-rule probabilities; the matrix/wave formulations.

sub_wrappers.name: Quantum field theory / second quantization
sub_wrappers.kernel: Fields promoted to operators; particles as field excitations; the framework gravity must be quantized INTO (or against).

sub_wrappers.name: Gauge theory + renormalization (the QFT success machinery)
sub_wrappers.kernel: Local gauge invariance + the renormalization that tames infinities for the OTHER three forces — and whose FAILURE for gravity (non-renormalizability) is the central obstruction.

sub_wrappers.name: The ACTION PRINCIPLE / Lagrangian-Hamiltonian variational formalism (SHARED deep root)
sub_wrappers.kernel: Euler-Lagrange / Hamilton / Jacobi variational mechanics — BOTH parents are built on it (Einstein-Hilbert action for GR; path-integral and canonical quantization for QM). A REAL shared root BELOW the seam S: the parents already overlap in their substructure, which is part of why a weld feels possible.
sub_wrappers.who_called_it: Euler, Lagrange, Hamilton, Jacobi (18th-19th c.); Einstein-Hilbert action (Hilbert 1915).

sub_wrappers.name: SYMMETRY / group theory (SHARED deep root)
sub_wrappers.kernel: Lie groups; Noether's theorem (1918) tying symmetry to conservation; the diffeomorphism group for GR vs internal gauge groups for QFT. The DISPUTE over the weld is largely a dispute over WHICH symmetry is fundamental (diffeomorphism invariance vs background Poincare/conformal) — so this shared root is also a fault line.

sub_wrappers.name: Penrose spin networks / SU(2) recoupling (tooling sub-wrapper, became load-bearing in LQG)
sub_wrappers.kernel: Combinatorial graphs labelled by SU(2) representations; the orphaned 1964 tool that turned out to label LQG's quantum-geometry states.

sub_wrappers.name: Conformal field theory + Calabi-Yau geometry (tooling sub-wrapper, load-bearing in strings)
sub_wrappers.kernel: 2D CFT on the string worldsheet; Calabi-Yau compactification of the extra dimensions.

sub_wrappers.name: Knot theory + topological QFT (tooling sub-wrappers, entered via the loop representation)
sub_wrappers.kernel: Knot invariants (entered LQG via the loop representation, Rovelli-Smolin 1988); topological quantum field theory.

A descendant that arguably OUTGREW the parent program and now feeds BACK into quantum-information and condensed-matter physics. The single most successful thing the search produced.
descendants._confidence_note: Higher confidence (0.8) than the candidate children themselves, because AdS/CFT is a CONCRETE, calculationally-validated correspondence (a realized unification), not a candidate-for-the-final-child.

descendants.name: Effective field theory of gravity (Donoghue) — the modest, AGREED descendant
descendants.what: Treats GR as a low-energy EFT and computes leading quantum corrections without resolving the UV. The part of the weld that DOES work and is UNCONTROVERSIAL across all camps — the quiet success amid the contested grand programs.
descendants._confidence_note: Highest descendant confidence: EFT-of-gravity is uncontested and computationally validated; everyone agrees it is correct as far as it goes.

descendants.name: Quantum-gravity phenomenology (adjacent field seeded, born ~1997)
descendants.what: The attempt to make the frontier EMPIRICAL: Planck-scale Lorentz-violation tests, gamma-ray-burst photon timing, tabletop entanglement-of-gravity experiments (Bose-Marletto-Vedral 2017 proposal).

cultural_harvest.what: WORMHOLES (Einstein-Rosen bridges — the 'ER' of ER=EPR) as the central device of Carl Sagan's 'Contact' (1985, with Kip Thorne consulting) and Christopher Nolan's 'Interstellar' (2014, Thorne again — the black-hole 'Gargantua' render became an actual physics paper).

The SIMULATION / HOLOGRAPHIC-UNIVERSE trope ('reality is a projection from a lower-dimensional boundary') diffused from the holographic principle into popular culture, fiction, and philosophy-of-mind speculation.

Planck-scale 'spacetime foam' and 'granular space' imagery (Wheeler's 'quantum foam'; the LQG spin-network mesh) recur in science-art visualizations and museum installations as the visual shorthand for 'the smallest scale'.

The very phrase 'Theory of Everything' (popularized around the string program) became a cultural target — book/film 'The Theory of Everything', and the framing of physics as a quest for one final unifying equation.

relatives._comment: WIDE edges (OPTIONAL group, flagged in SCHEMA.md §5). Cousins / influences / siblings / rivals spanning the physical AND latent. For QG, the most important WIDE edges are the RIVAL CANDIDATE CHILDREN themselves — which is exactly the anomaly: in a settled convergence the children are descendants (UP); here the 'children' behave like RIVALS (WIDE), because none is THE child. This mis-placement is a symptom of the missing rival-children variable.

edges.name: Asymptotic safety (Weinberg's program)
edges.note: A fourth candidate line: gravity may be non-perturbatively renormalizable via a UV fixed point. A cousin-weld over the same seam S, keeping QFT methods but seeking a non-trivial fixed point.

edges.name: Twistor theory (Penrose)
edges.note: Penrose's alternative geometric substrate; a cousin-line that re-encodes spacetime in twistor space, later feeding amplitude methods (twistor strings, amplituhedron).

edges.name: Noncommutative geometry (Connes)
edges.note: A cousin approach in which spacetime coordinates fail to commute at the Planck scale — another way to grant geometry quantum structure.

edges.name: Semiclassical gravity (Rosenfeld -> Mattingly)
edges.note: The DISSENTING rival that denies the weld is needed at all: quantum matter coupled to CLASSICAL spacetime. If correct, there IS no child — W_C is a category error. The falsifier-of-the-weld. (See discrepancies.)

edges.name: Electroweak / strong-force unification (the prior unifications)
edges.note: The SETTLED siblings: EM+weak -> electroweak (Glashow-Weinberg-Salam) and the strong force in the Standard Model are the welds that DID consummate, against which gravity's stubborn non-fusion stands out. The contrast is the point: same kind of unification ambition, opposite outcome.

edges.name: LCAO / Molecular Orbital Theory (Phase-1 convergence #1)
edges.note: STRUCTURAL cousin across the Phase-1 DB: LCAO is the SETTLED orbital-superposition weld (two orbitals -> one MO, closed-form). QG is the UNsettled superposition-of-frameworks weld at the spacetime substrate. LCAO shows what a consummated version of this kind of weld looks like; QG is its frontier mirror. This is the cleanest link back to the extends-target.

fuzzy_layer._comment: The trunk/frontier partition. For THIS specimen the partition is unusually inverted: the PARENTS and the SEAM are certain core, but the CHILD — normally the trunk's crown — is itself in the frontier (it is a conjecture). So the certain core is the LOWER half of the tree (parents + seam + deep shared roots), and the frontier is BOTH the deep people-roots AND the entire would-be canopy (the child + rival children). A conjecture = a low-confidence weld drawn but not confirmed; here the whole child IS that conjecture.
certain_core: W_B = Quantum Mechanics / QFT (parent, 0.99) — most precisely tested theory in physics.
The seam S exists and is genuine (Planck scale / graviton / black-hole entropy S=A/4 / singularities) — agreed across all camps (0.9).
Black-hole entropy S=A/4 (Bekenstein-Hawking) is a real, hard, shared constraint (0.93).
GR is perturbatively non-renormalizable ('t Hooft-Veltman 1973; Goroff-Sagnotti 1985-86) — a confirmed no-go (0.9).
The field-level dormancy 1970-1983 and the 1984-94 two-sided revival are well-documented (0.85).

SOME reconciliation/effective description is needed in regime S — even dissenters agree quantum matter and gravity must be jointly describable somehow (effective field theory of gravity works) (0.85).
The action principle and symmetry/group theory are shared deep roots of BOTH parents (0.8-0.85).
frontier: THE CHILD ITSELF: 'quantum gravity' as a single settled W_C — a ~90-year-old open conjecture; may never consolidate or may be the wrong question (0.4). The crown of the tree is in the frontier — the specimen's signature.
Which candidate is the right child (string vs LQG vs causal sets vs asymptotic safety vs ...) — unresolved; sociologically loaded (0.3-0.7 spread, no winner).
Whether the weld is even NEEDED (semiclassical-gravity dissent) — a live minority position that there is no child (0.45).
Bronstein as 'first quantum-gravitist' — contested priority, recently reconstructed history (0.8 but disputed).
The exact span of the spin-network dormancy (1964 vs 1971 start; ~20 vs ~25 years) — date conflict across sources (0.7).
Deep tooling roots (spin networks, CFT/Calabi-Yau, knot theory, TQFT becoming load-bearing) — medium confidence, lineage-specific (0.7-0.75).
Quantum-gravity phenomenology yielding any empirical signal — aspirational frontier (0.5-0.65).
The Wikidata structured influence-graph for QG — NOT cleanly harvested this pass (only adjacents confirmed); a provenance gap (low confidence in the structured-graph backbone).

discrepancies._comment: THE central framework-vs-record tension and the single most valuable row in the specimen.
discrepancies.what: The schema renders parents -> ONE child W_C, but the real record has TWO-plus RIVAL proposed children over the SAME two parents and the SAME seam S — string/M-theory (covariant line), loop quantum gravity (canonical line), and the sum-over-histories descendants (causal sets, CDT, spin foams), plus asymptotic safety, twistors, noncommutative geometry. They are NOT sub-welds of one pushout; they DISAGREE about what the child even is and call each other's child the wrong question. The schema has NO slot for 'a weld with multiple competing, mutually-rejecting candidate outputs and no winner'.
sources_in_conflict: 'Contested Boundaries: The String Theory Debates' (MIT Press)
discrepancies.why_interesting: Exposes the schema's missing CONTESTED-WELD / RIVAL-CHILDREN variable. The 9 settled convergences each had ONE child; QG is the control case where the same two parents + same S produce a FORK, not a fusion. Recommends adding {candidate_children[], unresolved:true, contest_axis} to the weld. QG is the cleanest case making this blind spot visible.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Caps child-confidence at ~0.4 (there is no single child to be confident in); RAISES the value of the specimen as a schema-stress-test.

discrepancies._comment: Which parent dominates the weld is itself the fault line.
discrepancies.what: The DIRECTION of the weld is disputed. Covariant/string line = QFT-method applied TO gravity (perturbative graviton on a fixed background; W_B's machinery SWALLOWS W_A) and is accused by the other camp of NOT being background-independent. Canonical/LQG line = GR's background-independence is PRIMARY and QM is rebuilt on it (W_A SWALLOWS W_B). SEP: 'there is no firm definition of background independence on the table... two camps almost certainly talking past each other.'
discrepancies.why_interesting: The shared sub-object S is AGREED, but the DIRECTION of the weld (which parent's kernel is kept vs reformed) is disputed — a variable the SYMMETRIC two-parent schema flattens. Suggests a weld needs a 'dominance_axis' / 'which_parent_reformed' field.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Splits the would-be child into direction-dependent variants; keeps frame_of_weld engaging {meaning} (the dispute is partly definitional).

discrepancies._comment: Priority / origin of the FIELD — genuinely multi-origin.
discrepancies.what: Rovelli (gr-qc/0006061) dates first awareness to Einstein 1916 (quantum effects must modify GR), Klein 1927 (QG modifies space-time concepts), Rosenfeld early-1930s (first technical papers). But the 'cube of theories' framing is credited to Gamow-Ivanenko-Landau (1928), DEVELOPED by Bronstein (1935 dissertation, 1936 papers). 'Graviton' first named ~1934 (Blokhintsev-Galperin). NO single founder.
discrepancies.why_interesting: The people-(0) ROOT is genuinely multi-origin and the canonical originator is contested — exactly the fuzzy deep-root frontier the schema predicts (low-confidence who-called-it at the base). Confirms the schema's expectation that confidence should fade in the deep roots.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Holds Bronstein/founder confidence at ~0.8; validates the certain-core->frontier gradient by example.

discrepancies._comment: Contested DORMANCY for an EXTERNAL/physical-frame reason.
discrepancies.what: Matvei Bronstein's mid-1930s work (quantization of weak gravity; the realization that GR's mass-density bound forces rejecting Riemannian geometry and 'our ordinary concepts of space and time') was largely neglected for decades — partly because he was EXECUTED by the Soviet NKVD in Feb 1938 at age 32 (nephew of Trotsky). Reconstructed only recently (Stachel; Gorelik & Frenkel biography). Rovelli: in Russia remembered by some as 'smarter than Landau'.
discrepancies.why_interesting: A real-record example of a ROOT node going dormant for EXTERNAL (political/biographical, physical-frame) reasons, NOT internal-to-the-idea reasons — a dormancy cause the schema's 'why' field should TAG by frame (people-(0) deaths/purges can sever a lineage). Distinct in KIND from the field-level dormancy (knowledge-frame no-go theorems) and the spin-network dormancy (tool-orphaning).
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Motivates a dormancy.why_frame tag (physical vs knowledge frame); does not move child-confidence but enriches the root layer.

discrepancies._comment: Naming/attribution conflict on the canonical line's keystone equation.
discrepancies.what: DeWitt long called it the 'Einstein-Schrodinger equation' and attributed it to Wheeler; Wheeler called it the 'DeWitt equation'; only in 1988 (Osgood Hill conference) did DeWitt concede the now-standard 'Wheeler-DeWitt equation'. Paper written 1966, published 1967 (delayed, partly over publication charges).
discrepancies.why_interesting: A clean MICRO-case of a node's name and credit being unstable for ~20 years — the schema's 'who_called_it' field is genuinely TIME-DEPENDENT and disputed even among the originators THEMSELVES. Suggests who_called_it may need a time-stamp / 'name settled when' sub-field.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Lowers the precision (not the existence) of the Wheeler-DeWitt root's attribution; a who_called_it volatility example.

discrepancies._comment: Is the weld even NECESSARY? The falsifier-of-the-weld.
discrepancies.what: A dissenting MINORITY (traceable to Rosenfeld; defended by Mattingly 2006-2014 against Eppley-Hannah 1977 / Page-Geilker 1981) holds gravity may NOT need to be quantized — quantum matter could couple to CLASSICAL spacetime (semiclassical gravity). If so, there is NO weld at all; W_C is a category error.
sources_in_conflict: Eppley-Hannah 1977 / Page-Geilker 1981 (arguments that gravity must be quantized)
discrepancies.why_interesting: A LIVE position that the parents should NOT be welded — the schema has no representation for 'some serious observers deny a third is needed'. This is the FALSIFIER-OF-THE-WELD case, the strongest form of the fuzzy frontier. Recommends a first-class 'weld_necessity_confidence' field (is a third even wanted?), not buried in discrepancies.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Directly lowers child-confidence (there may be no child at all); makes 'is a third needed?' an explicit axis.

discrepancies._comment: Whig-vs-revisionist on string theory's status — the meaning-frame contest.
discrepancies.what: String theory has been by-headcount-dominant since the mid-1980s 'first/second superstring revolutions'; Witten (1995): 'the mathematics of the next millennium will be dominated by string theory.' Revisionist counter-narrative (Smolin 'The Trouble with Physics' 2006; Woit 'Not Even Wrong' 2006): unfalsifiable landscape, no Planck-scale predictions, SUSY non-appearance at the LHC. Rovelli (2016): 'the string planet is infinitely less arrogant than ten years ago.'
discrepancies.why_interesting: The 'which proposed child is winning' judgment is SOCIOLOGICALLY loaded and has PARTIALLY REVERSED over time — a reminder that 'status' on a frontier weld is observer- and era-relative, not a view-from-nowhere fact. This is precisely why frame_of_weld here engages {meaning}: the weld's adjudication is happening in the social/meaning frame.
discrepancies.confidence_impact: Keeps any single candidate-child's 'winning' confidence soft and era-relative; justifies the meaning-frame tag on the weld.

_schema_gaps_in_record: STATUS ENUM GAP (#1 enum gap): the child's lifecycle value should be 'open-conjecture' / 'live-unconsummated-weld' / 'perpetual-frontier' — NONE of {risen,active,dormant,resurrected,stale} fits a ~90-year-old high-synergy weld that has NEVER produced a settled child. The schema implicitly assumes welds RESOLVE; this one hasn't. Recommend adding the new status value.

MISSING VARIABLE — RIVAL/COMPETING CHILDREN (the single biggest gap): 'weld' maps parents -> ONE W_C, but here the SAME two parents + SAME seam S yield a FAMILY of mutually-rejecting candidate children (string, LQG, causal sets, CDT, asymptotic safety, ...). There is no field for candidate_children[] with their contest axis (which-parent-dominates; background-dependent-vs-independent) and no field for 'no winner yet'. QG is the cleanest case exposing this blind spot. Recommend {candidate_children[], unresolved:true, contest_axis}.

SURVIVED/DROPPED ARE NOT SINGLE-VALUED: each rival child drops a DIFFERENT parent-feature (string drops GR's background-independence; LQG drops QM's fixed time/continuum; semiclassical drops the weld itself). Flat survived[]/dropped[] arrays cannot record 'dropped-BY-which-child'. Needs a per-candidate survived/dropped, or a {feature, kept_by[], dropped_by[]} matrix.

WELD-NECESSITY IS ITSELF CONTESTED: there is no field to record that a serious minority denies the weld should happen at all (semiclassical gravity). The schema assumes the third is WANTED; 'is a third even needed?' should be a first-class confidence (weld_necessity_confidence), not buried in discrepancies.

DORMANCY 'WHY' NEEDS A FRAME TAG: this specimen has dormancy at THREE grains with different-FRAME causes — internal/knowledge-frame (field stagnation 1970-83), tool-orphaning/knowledge-frame (spin networks 1964/71-88), and EXTERNAL physical/political-frame (Bronstein's purge ~1938-1990s). The single 'why' string can't capture that a lineage can be severed by physical-frame events (a death) vs knowledge-frame events (a no-go theorem). Recommend dormancy.why_frame.

SURPRISE/SYNERGY vs CONSOLIDATION ARE DECOUPLED: the schema (and the Phase-1 DB's whole logic) ties high synergy to a RISEN child. QG shows synergy can be enormous and real while the child stays UNBORN for a lifetime — so surprise_confidence (0.85, synergy is real) and child-confidence (0.4, child may never settle / may be the wrong question) must be allowed to diverge SHARPLY. Worth making explicit that these are INDEPENDENT axes.

BITS_NOTE LEFT QUALITATIVE BY NECESSITY (principled null): the description-length question ('would the sought child compress the two-theory corpus?') is GENUINELY UNDEFINED while the child doesn't exist — you cannot MDL-score a theory you don't have. This is a principled, not lazy, blank; flag that FRONTIER specimens may have intrinsically-null bits until/unless a child consolidates.

WIKIDATA STRUCTURED GRAPH NOT CLEANLY HARVESTED: guessed QID failed; only 'canonical quantum gravity' (Q2067074) and 'problem of time' (Q18344764) confirmed adjacent. The aggregator backbone leans on SEP + Rovelli + Wikipedia rather than a verified Wikidata influence-graph — a real provenance gap to close in a later pass.
